topic: Street giveaway: YouTuber/producer hands out all his Beats headphones to strangers at night, promise made if France won the World Cup (per transcript)
hero: Young man in pink Adidas jacket and plaid scarf with blue crossbody bag (creator DaHood per description)
hook: Man in pink jacket in a car back seat opens a white Beats box, quick cut to approaching stranger at car window at night
reaction_overlays: Instagram story screenshot overlay inset left at ~20s; no stickers
transition_summary: Cinematic handheld, quick hard cuts and some whip pans; ~3.5 cuts/10s (21 cuts in 70s); warm night grading
audio_note: Spanish dialogue/voice-over ('Guys, new YouTube video. Like I said, if we won the World Cup I'd give away... 100 Beats giveaway') plus ambient street sound and music

reuse_segments.what: Own-shot street giveaway scenes with Beats boxes
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: Own production; recreate with own actors and generic headphone boxes (avoid Beats branding) in same handheld night style
